title: Missions / Daily missions
one_line: Mission rows with progress and CLAIM, a bonus chest well, CLAIM ALL on the bottom edge.

anatomy.spec: Standard NX Card, nameplate NX MISSIONS.
A well holding the bonus chest, unlocking as missions complete.
Mission row (bible 5.7): icon well, title, progress bar (bible 5.12), reward, CLAIM button.
CLAIM ALL, go green, straddling the bottom edge in a collar - enabled only when at least one mission is claimable.

states: All claimed - CLAIM ALL disabled, empty-ish state until reset
motion: Row progress fill animates smoothly on open, not instantly.
data: DailyMissionsData. Owner brief on exact mission set is still pending per IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 11 - build the chassis and progress/claim mechanics now, swap the content when the brief arrives.
do_not: Do not let CLAIM ALL be tappable with nothing to claim.
Do not hard-code the mission list if the owner's brief is still pending - keep it data-driven.
acceptance: Every mission shows correct live progress.
CLAIM and CLAIM ALL work and count up rewards.
Bonus chest state reflects real completion.
steps: 1. Preflight - check AI_HANDOFF.md for the owner's missions brief; if absent, build to bible 5.7/6.7 with placeholder mission content clearly swappable.
2. Rebuild the chassis with nameplate and bonus chest well.
3. Build mission rows with live progress bars.
4. Wire CLAIM per row and CLAIM ALL.
5. Capture in-progress, claimable and all-claimed. Postflight.
